description: This file defines the IPCMessage class used for encoding and decoding IPC protocol messages, including request and reply handling with JSON payloads.

classes.name: IPCMessage
classes.description: A class for encoding and decoding IPC messages, supporting request and reply formats with payloads.

methods.name: decodeRequest
methods.description: Decodes an IPC request message from an InputStream.

methods.name: decodeReply
methods.description: Decodes an IPC reply message from an InputStream.

methods.name: encodeRequest
methods.description: Encodes the IPC request message to an OutputStream.

methods.name: encodeReply
methods.description: Encodes the IPC reply message to an OutputStream.

methods.name: getMessageCode
methods.description: Returns the message code for a request.

methods.name: setMessageCode
methods.description: Sets the message code for a request.

methods.name: getReturnCode
methods.description: Returns the return code for a reply.

methods.name: setReturnCode
methods.description: Sets the return code for a reply.
